name: darkest_swampy
comment: Swampy Pit (113_act3.py, on level 90): four open blocks of Kurast's ruins in a 2x2 square (two slums, two metro), borrowing the Kurast Bazaar's look but keeping the Swampy Pit's name. Replaced the pit's treasure room (act3/jungle/dungrm1a) on 2026-11-24: walls cut it into corridors, and only about a tenth of it could be reached.
